excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist, long blonde hair, tanned skin, wearing a white sun hat. Wears a light pink blouse worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts and pink hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Chiseling Matrix Layers on a High-Relief Badland Ridge

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_1, sporting her signature white sun hat, taps a flat steel chisel with her geology hammer into a brittle layer of ochre siltstone on a sun-drenched hill outcrop. A clean split in the rock neatly partitions the matrix to unearth the robust, heavily fused nasal bones of a Daspletosaurus skull. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
